lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid of approximately 5-7 horizontal rows and 10-12 vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical linear bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming anchor nodes in a lattice-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting sharp luminance transitions from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadows on the ventral edge.
